title: Event
description: A verified event, as the website and newsletter read it. Written only by the verifier (facts), the listing writer (the 'listing' block) and the event storyteller and event story checker (the 'story' and 'story_research' blocks). Lives in data/events/<YYYY-MM>/<id>.json. Public text (the listing blurb) is written later from confirmed fields only; the scout's summary is not carried over.

run_schedule.description: For runs (exhibitions, theatre runs, special menus over several days): opening days and times in the source's own words, e.g. 'Tue–Sun 11am–6pm' or 'Tue–Sat 7.30pm, Sat matinee 2.30pm'. Needs evidence like any other fact.

evidence.description: Only evidence items the verifier confirmed.

outcome.description: verified = every filled field confirmed; verified-with-gaps = key facts confirmed, some optional fields removed because they could not be confirmed.

removed_fields.description: Fields the scout filled in that the verifier could not confirm and therefore emptied.

record.description: Path to the verification record, e.g. data/verification/2026-10-13/<id>.json

editor_note.description: The scout's opinion (why_its_good), carried over for the newsletter editor. Internal only: never shown to the public.

listing.description: Filled by the listing writer later. Null until then.

story.description: The longer read under 'The story' on the event page, written by the event storyteller: who is on and what they have done, when the night or series started and its history, what is special about this one, what it is like, and other things worth knowing. Every part is our own words and backed by quotes in story.evidence. The site shows it only after the event story checker's review is newer than written_at. Null until written; the verifier sets it to null when the title or line-up changes.

started.description: When the night, series or festival began (or when the act formed), as a source states it, e.g. '2014, as a monthly night at the Sebright Arms'.

then.description: The history of the night or series, or of the act: past editions, moves, organisers, releases. Our own words.

who.description: Who is on: the acts, artists, speakers, chefs or teachers, what they have done and what named publications have said about them, attributed. Only professional facts, never private life or looks.

now.description: What is special about this edition or this run (a launch, an anniversary, a tour, the theme), from sources no more than five years old.

vibe.description: What it is like, only as sources describe it (past editions, the act live, the show), attributed where it is a judgement. Never describes people by age, race, class or looks.

worth_knowing.description: Up to five short facts a reader would enjoy, our own words.

evidence.description: The quotes behind the story, separate from the event's own evidence (which only the verifier writes).

fields.description: Which parts of the story this quote backs: 'story' for all of it, or 'story.started', 'story.then', 'story.who', 'story.now', 'story.vibe', 'story.worth_knowing'.

quote.description: One contiguous snippet copied word for word from the page, 10 to 300 characters.

source_kind.description: primary = the event's, act's, organiser's or venue's own page; press = an article or review by a named publication; directory = a reference or heritage listing, a label or agency roster; aggregator = a listings site that copies others.

source_date.description: When the page was written or last updated, if it shows one. A source over five years old may back story.started and story.then (history) but not story.now or story.vibe.

review.description: The event story checker's stamp: every story quote re-fetched and every part compared with its quotes. Older than written_at, it doesn't count.

removed_fields.description: Story parts emptied because nothing backed them, e.g. 'story.vibe'.

story_research.description: Internal bookkeeping for the event storyteller, never shown on the site. An event whose story is still short after a try waits a week after last_attempt, never sooner (and is dropped once it is over).

outcome.description: written = the story reaches 6 lines; partial = something was added but it is shorter; nothing-found = nothing quotable was found.

next_check.description: last_attempt + 7 days unless the outcome is written (then null).

history.description: What changed after first publication, newest last.

needs_review.description: Set when something about a published event is in doubt (a held update, a page that vanished, a possible date change). The site must hide the event or show it as 'details being checked' while this is set.
